vendor_model_calibration.basis: Normalize the exterior fixed socket collar of vendor GLB body node0 to the sibling neoFit P=.610in=15.494mm diameter. This is the short outlet socket body, not the larger check-valve barrel and not the stylized tube opening.

exterior_collar_landmark.source_correspondence: The outer cylindrical female socket collar below the release collet; sibling sheets label its maximum diameter P

vendor_model_calibration.method: Transform both collet lip-plane centers into body node0; project onto its Y axis; subtract the inlet projection; apply the family exterior-collar scale. Straighten small source collet tilts into shared coaxial interfaces.
vendor_model_calibration.internal_media_scope: The display model has a stylized oval tube corridor. Nominal6.35mm tube passages and family16.891mm engagement are represented analytically; the internal display mesh does not control scale or insertion.
vendor_model_calibration.scope: Same-family exterior inference with no established dimensional tolerance. Decimal precision preserves one shared CAD datum and is not measurement accuracy.

model_mm.molded_form_status: Revolved circular fixed-case envelope and analytic oval collet lips. Small source ring duplicates are simplified. Grip teeth, seals, spring and poppet are not modeled.

native_frame.origin: Midpoint between nominal collet mouth planes
native_frame.flow_status: Inferred from supplier cutaway, not verified on the purchased part

socket_insertion.basis: Same-family inference from published ATEU44 B and ATRU444 B2/B3=.665in. ACHV44-specific tube stop and operating collet plane remain unmeasured.

limits: No physical dimensional, release-stroke, insertion, sealing, gripping, cracking-pressure or reverse-leak test is recorded by this model.
CAD contact and clearance results apply to this nominal exterior; they do not establish installed hardware fit, pressure suitability or service life.
Supports bear only on the fixed cylindrical band; moving collets remain outside that bearing band.

same_family_inference.scope: These values are published for the sibling fittings. Corresponding ACHV44 values remain unmeasured family inferences, not published ACHV44 dimensions.

axial_consistency.interpretation: The two nominal inserted tube ends do not overlap. The remaining axial space is a packaging consistency check, not a valve-internal design or performance qualification.
